name: assertItemNotFound
text: Assert that the given error is ReadingListError.itemNotFound. Uses pattern matching instead of Equatable to avoid a retroactive protocol conformance on a type owned by the main module.

name: waitForErrorState

name: waitForState
text: Spin until the service reaches one of the target states or attempts run out. ReadingPlaybackState is Equatable but not Hashable (the .error case carries a String), so targets are matched with a linear contains.
